page.title: Joint account
page.description: Share one funding account with a spouse, family member, partner or agent

actingFor.primarySuspended: The joint account's primary applicant has been suspended, so you can't operate this account right now. Switch back to your own account or contact the primary applicant.
actingFor.primaryKycNotVerified: The joint account's primary applicant hasn't passed identity verification. Contact the primary applicant.
actingFor.restrictedTitle: Switch back to your own account to do this
actingFor.restrictedDesc: You're operating a joint account. Identity verification, referral binding and joint account applications or membership changes can only be made from your own account.

session.invalid: Your joint account session is no longer valid. Sign in again.

delegated.title: You're operating {{name}}
delegated.desc: Applications, renaming, consent and leaving are managed from your own account. Transfers between your funds and joint accounts work in either mode.

consent.title: Requests waiting for you ({{count}})
consent.desc: Someone has applied to add you to their joint account. If you accept, the application goes to review; nothing changes until it's approved.
consent.accepted: Request accepted. It's now waiting for review.

intro.title: Open a joint account
intro.addMemberTitle: Add a member to your joint account
intro.unavailable: New applications aren't available right now.

points.ownership: Funds, wallet and verification stay yours
points.switch: The member switches in with their own account
points.exit: Remove the member or dissolve the account anytime

intro.prepare: You'll need proof of relationship and the other person's UID or ID

apply.title: Apply for a joint account

modeHint.existing: Goes to review after they accept
modeHint.invite: Get a registration link after approval

apply.memberUidHint: Their UID is on their profile page. They must have passed identity verification; if the application is returned, you can’t submit to the same UID again for 24 hours.

memberNotEligible.not_eligible: Check that the UID is correct, then ask this user to confirm that their identity verification is approved, their account is active, and they haven't reached the maximum number of joint accounts.
memberNotEligible.self: You can't add yourself as a member. Enter the other person's UID.

apply.incomplete: Fill in every field and upload the required files.
apply.kycRequiredDesc: Only verified customers can apply for a joint account.
apply.proofMeta: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 20 MB
apply.ready: Everything is in. Ready to submit

desc.pending_consent: The member hasn't accepted yet. We'll notify you when they respond.
desc.pending_review: We're reviewing the application and will notify you of the result.
desc.rejected: Check the reason below, then apply again.

application.memberGoneDesc: The application was approved, but this member is no longer on the joint account. To add a member, apply again.
application.cancelConfirm: The application will stop here. If you invited an existing user, they'll be told it was cancelled.

owned.desc: You're the primary applicant. You don't need to switch accounts; the member switches to this account to operate it.
owned.removeConfirm: The member immediately loses access to this account and is signed out of it. Their own account and assets aren't affected. You'll confirm with a security check.
owned.dissolveConfirm: The member immediately loses access and the joint account closes. Your own funds stay with you. You'll confirm with a security check.

label.title: Rename joint account
label.description: Members see this name when they switch to the account. Past notifications keep the name they were sent with.
label.hint: {{count}}/{{max}} characters. Leave empty to remove the name.

invitation.title: Member registration link
invitation.keepPrivate: Anyone with this link can register as the member of your joint account. Send it only to the person you applied for.
invitation.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the link. Select it and copy it manually.
invitation.unavailable: The link isn't available right now
invitation.contactSupportHint: Contact support to get a new link.

memberships.title: Joint accounts you belong to ({{count}})
memberships.desc: Switch to a joint account to operate its funds. Your own account and wallet stay separate.
memberships.notificationsHint: Inbox and email copies of this account's fund activity. Real-time updates still arrive when this is off.
memberships.leaveWithdrawFirst: Move any funds you need into your own account before leaving.
memberships.leaveConfirm: Leaving doesn't return funds already transferred and doesn't close your own account. You'll lose access to this joint account right away.

transfer.title: Transfer between accounts
transfer.description: Move funds between your funding account and the joint account's funding account.
transfer.securityHint: The first transfer in each direction asks for your fund password and one more verification. Both of you must have passed identity verification.
transfer.snapshotHint: Balances shown are as of this transfer, not live. Check your assets page for current balances.

denial.kyc_required: Both you and the primary applicant must pass identity verification before transferring.
denial.party_not_active: Your account or the primary applicant's account isn't active, so transfers are unavailable.
denial.membership_inactive: You're no longer a member of this joint account. Refresh the page.
denial.joint_account_inactive: This joint account is no longer active.
denial.invalid_accounts: Transfers must be between the funding accounts of two different users.

register.previewPrimary: You're registering as the member of the joint account of UID {{uid}} ({{name}}).
register.previewPrimaryUidOnly: You're registering as the member of the joint account of UID {{uid}}.
register.previewWarning: If these details aren't right, don't continue. Registering doesn't verify your identity; you'll still need to verify before withdrawing or transferring.
register.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
register.requiresNewAccount: This invitation only works with a new account, and this email or phone is already registered. Use one that hasn't been registered, or ask the primary applicant to add your existing account instead.
register.resendCode: Request a new verification code and try again.
register.loggedInElsewhere: This invitation is for a new account. Sign out first, then register with an email or phone that hasn't been used here.

issue.not_usable: This invitation link has already been used or is no longer valid.
issue.expired: This invitation link has expired. Ask the primary applicant to contact support for a new one.

register.issueFallback: You can still register a regular account below.

selfSettings.notice: You're operating a joint account. Changes here apply to your own sign-in and security settings, not the primary applicant's.

memberCan.a: Switch to the joint account to operate its funds, and transfer between their own funding account and the joint account. Their own account and wallet stay separate.

memberSteps.q: What does the other person need to do?
memberSteps.a: If they already have an account, they accept your request before it goes to review. If they don't, you send them a registration link after approval.

dissolve.a: Dissolve it on this page anytime. The member loses access immediately, and your own funds stay with you.
